title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: A test source set written with its own src prefix now covers its build variants, the same way the shorter form already did.

highlights.title: Source sets written with src
highlights.description: A setting of `src/test/kotlin` now covers `src/testDebug/kotlin` too. The rule read it as the pair `src` then `test`, looked for a variant of `src`, and found none.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: What the setting names after the source set is still required exactly, so `src/testDebug/res` stays out.
Checked against a real Android project of 5088 files: the sweep reports zero anomaly and no production file is read as test code.
